evals.prompt: Synthetic planning request: Three separate batches this month omitted the required region field and each needed manual correction. A fourth complete batch succeeded. Propose prevention only. The intake maintainer is known, but nobody has assigned this work.
evals.expected_output: A scoped intake prevention proposal with recurrence evidence, ownership marked proposed, early signal, and benefit/harm measurement.
assertions: Uses the three distinct batches as recurrence evidence and preserves the successful counterexample.
Proposes the earliest practical relevant prevention point without claiming the omission origin is proven.
Labels maintainer ownership as proposed rather than assigned.
Measures recurrence reduction and possible rejection of valid batches without implementing the control.

evals.prompt: Synthetic active incident: The queue is blocked now; local containment is already authorized. There were two similar blocks last week, but causes are unknown. Draft a future prevention proposal without delaying the operator who is containing the active incident.
evals.expected_output: A proposal separating immediate containment from future prevention, preserving uncertainty and bounded follow-up.
assertions: Does not require root-cause completion before urgent authorized containment.
Does not treat similar symptoms as proof of one cause.
Provides a narrow proposed signal or discriminating check and states its limits.
Does not expand authority into external changes or assigning people.

evals.prompt: Synthetic planning request: These three notes all quote incident A, which happened once. Prevent this recurring failure. There is no other incident evidence.
evals.expected_output: An explicit finding that recurrence is not established and a narrower next investigation.
assertions: Counts the duplicated notes as one incident rather than three recurrences.
Does not manufacture a recurring cause or claim a proven prevention control.
Offers a scoped question or check rather than a broad redesign.

evals.prompt: Plan only: three customer downloads remained pending overnight even though internal job logs said success. Customers could not obtain the file until support manually retried delivery. The cause is unknown; internal error counts were zero. Propose narrow prevention and an early signal.
evals.expected_output: A proposal using the incomplete customer download as a signal with qualified cause, ownership, benefit and harm checks.
assertions: Does not equate successful jobs or zero errors with a completed customer journey.
Proposes a signal tied to pending delivery and an actionable intervention.
Keeps uncertain cause and proposed ownership explicit.
Does not install broad monitoring or implement without approval.
